MEETING BRIEF: Northstar Recruitment

OVERVIEW
Northstar Recruitment has 8 recruiters, each spending about 6 hours per week on manual admin. Two main operational problems: (1) slow candidate follow-ups and (2) inconsistent ATS records.

NUMBERS & ASSUMPTIONS
- Total weekly admin time: 8 recruiters x 6 hrs = 48 hours/week
- Approx. annual: 48 x 52 weeks = 2,496 hours/year
- Approx. monthly: 2,496 / 12 = 208 hours/month
- Assumptions: 6 hrs/week is an average per recruiter; 52 working weeks/year; no adjustment for holidays or part-time staff.

DISCOVERY QUESTIONS
1. Which admin tasks take the most of each recruiter's 6 hours per week (data entry, scheduling, email follow-ups, reporting)?
2. How are candidate follow-ups handled today, and where do delays occur (which stages, who owns them)?
3. Which ATS are you using, and what causes the inconsistent records (missing fields, duplicates, manual entry, differing team practices)?

AUTOMATION OPPORTUNITIES
1. Automated candidate follow-up: triggered emails/SMS and reminders at key pipeline stages.
2. ATS data hygiene: validation rules, duplicate detection, and auto-population of fields from CVs and emails.
3. Admin workflow automation: interview scheduling, status updates, and automated activity logging to the ATS.

NEXT STEP
Run a 30-60 minute discovery/workflow mapping session with 2-3 recruiters to quantify the admin time breakdown and pick one pilot (likely candidate follow-up automation).
